findings.body: Only Posting Date and money cells are checked with `hasUncachedFormula`. `readSourceRow` converts an uncached formula in any other column to `null`, after which this guard can skip a fully formula-driven row; an uncached formula in an optional column such as Comments or Plant is silently imported as null. This violates the requirement that any missing formula cache block use and request a recalculated, saved workbook. The tests cover only date and Debit formulas.
findings.title: Not done: Missing formula caches must block the entire Actual import

findings.body: This resolver recognizes only objects containing `formula`, but ExcelJS also represents copied-down formulas as `{ sharedFormula, result }`, as confirmed by [ExcelJS's CellValue contract](https://github.com/exceljs/exceljs/blob/master/index.d.ts). Consequently, valid cached shared formulas in date or money columns become `[object Object]`/invalid values instead of using their saved result, while shared formulas in retained text columns are corrupted. The new formula test exercises only the non-shared representation.
findings.title: Not done: Cached shared formulas must import from their saved results

findings.body: The permitted path list does not include `.factory/stories/FINANCIAL-AGENT-DEMO/tasks/ACTUAL-PARSER.json`, yet the branch still adds this task-state record. It is not needed by the parser or its tests and records stale review workflow state, so it must be removed from this scoped change.
findings.title: Remove the out-of-scope task-state artifact
